ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Cu(-|$)'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
GROUP BY m.formula
ORDER BY avg_formation_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.volume_per_atom <= 12
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Ir(-|$)'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements = 2
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
  )
  AND (ps.is_stable = TRUE OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.1)
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
  (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
GROUP BY m.formula
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.5 AND 3.7
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, cp.property_name, cp.value, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND cp.value >= 180.0
    AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Co'
  AND c.atomic_fraction >= 0.5
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       c.element AS b_site,
       c.atomic_fraction,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    substring(m.formula FROM '^([A-Z][a-z]?)') AS a_site,
    AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY substring(m.formula FROM '^([A-Z][a-z]?)')
ORDER BY avg_formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) <= 0.05
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_l12_al_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS unstable_l12_al_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
  )
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = FALSE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  m.source_db,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.crystal_system,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.space_group,
  s.lattice_a,
  s.lattice_b,
  s.lattice_c,
  s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12'
   OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable,
    cp.tensor_component,
    cp.value,
    cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Fe(-|$)'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.tensor_component IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
ORDER BY m.formula, cp.tensor_component
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.572) <= 0.03

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c_a.element AS a_site, c_b.element AS b_site
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY m.formula, c_a.element, c_b.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn|Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg|Rf|Db|Sg|Bh|Hs|Mt|Ds|Rg|Cn)(-|$)'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_c11.value AS C11,
    cp_c12.value AS C12,
    cp_c44.value AS C44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c11.property_name = 'elastic_tensor'
    AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c12.property_name = 'elastic_tensor'
    AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c44.property_name = 'elastic_tensor'
    AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp_c11.value > cp_c12.value
  AND cp_c44.value > 0
ORDER BY
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC,
    cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_a_deviation_from_ni3al
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  (
    0.4 * CASE
      WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
      ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)
    END
    + 0.3 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
    + 0.3 * (cp.value / 300.0)
  ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c.element = 'Ni'
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c.element = 'Co'
    )
  )
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  m.chemical_system AS element_combination,
  COUNT(*) AS count,
  AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12'
   OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_c11.value AS C11,
    cp_c12.value AS C12,
    cp_c44.value AS C44,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
        ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)
    END AS stability_score,
    1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS lattice_matching_score,
    ((cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value) / 3.0 + cp_c44.value) / 2.0 AS elastic_score,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
            ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)
        END
        * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
        * (((cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value) / 3.0 + cp_c44.value) / 2.0)
    ) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c11.property_name = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c12.property_name = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c44.property_name = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
GROUP BY m.formula
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.5 AND 3.7
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.value >= 180
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula LIKE 'Co3%'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.formula LIKE '%Al%'
   OR m.formula LIKE '%Ti%'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS shear_modulus, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'shear_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Ni(-|$)'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) <= 0.05
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_l12_al_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS unstable_l12_al_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
  )
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE calc.functional = 'GGA-PBE'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS mismatch
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.property_name, cp.tensor_component, cp.value, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE m.formula LIKE '%Fe%'
  AND (
    cp.property_name IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44', 'energy_above_hull', 'is_stable', 'formation_energy_per_atom')
    OR cp.tensor_component IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
  )
ORDER BY m.formula, cp.property_name, cp.tensor_component
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.energy_above_hull = 0
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn|Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg)(-|$)'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_stab.value AS phase_stability,
  cp_mis.value AS lattice_diff,
  cp_c11.value AS C11,
  cp_c12.value AS C12,
  cp_c44.value AS C44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stab ON cp_stab.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_stab.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
JOIN calculated_property cp_mis ON cp_mis.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_mis.property_name = 'lattice_mismatch'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c11.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c12.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c44.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE calc.calculation_type = 'L12'
ORDER BY cp_stab.value ASC, ABS(cp_mis.value) ASC, cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_a_mismatch_to_ni3al
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_stability.value AS energy_above_hull,
  ABS(cp_lattice.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_bulk.value AS bulk_modulus,
  (
    0.4 * (1.0 / (1.0 + cp_stability.value)) +
    0.3 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(cp_lattice.value - 3.57))) +
    0.3 * (cp_bulk.value / 300.0)
  ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc_stability ON calc_stability.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stability ON cp_stability.calculation_id = calc_stability.calculation_id
JOIN calculation calc_lattice ON calc_lattice.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_lattice ON cp_lattice.calculation_id = calc_lattice.calculation_id
JOIN calculation calc_bulk ON calc_bulk.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bulk ON cp_bulk.calculation_id = calc_bulk.calculation_id
WHERE cp_stability.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
  AND cp_lattice.property_name = 'lattice_a'
  AND cp_bulk.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND (
    m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Ni(-|$)'
    OR m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Co(-|$)'
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  m.chemical_system,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS material_count,
  AVG(cp.value) FILTER (WHERE cp.property_name = 'energy_above_hull') AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  AVG(cp.value) FILTER (WHERE cp.property_name = 'formation_energy_per_atom') AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND cp.property_name IN ('energy_above_hull', 'formation_energy_per_atom')
GROUP BY m.chemical_system
ORDER BY avg_energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST, material_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ABS(cp_a.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_c11.value AS "C11",
    cp_c12.value AS "C12",
    cp_c44.value AS "C44",
    (cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value) / 3.0 AS bulk_modulus,
    cp_stable.value AS is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_l12 ON cp_l12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_a ON cp_a.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stable ON cp_stable.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp_l12.property_name = 'L12'
  AND cp_l12.value = 1
  AND cp_a.property_name = 'lattice_a'
  AND cp_c11.property_name = 'C11'
  AND cp_c12.property_name = 'C12'
  AND cp_c44.property_name = 'C44'
  AND cp_stable.property_name = 'is_stable'
  AND cp_stable.value = 1
ORDER BY
    ABS(cp_a.value - 3.57) ASC,
    (cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value) / 3.0 DESC,
    cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stable ON cp_stable.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_l12 ON cp_l12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE m.formula LIKE '%Co%'
  AND cp_stable.property_name = 'is_stable'
  AND cp_stable.value = 1
  AND cp_l12.property_name = 'prototype_L12'
  AND cp_l12.value = 1
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.formula = 'Co3Ti'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 'Q1_negative_formation_energy_stable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.is_stable = FALSE THEN 'Q2_negative_formation_energy_unstable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 'Q3_positive_formation_energy_stable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.is_stable = FALSE THEN 'Q4_positive_formation_energy_unstable'
  END AS stability_quadrant
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
ORDER BY stability_quadrant ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       cp_lat.value AS lattice_a,
       ABS(cp_lat.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_lat ON cp_lat.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp_lat.property_name = 'lattice_a'
  AND m.chemical_system LIKE '%Ni%'
  AND m.chemical_system <> 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY ABS(cp_lat.value - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
JOIN calculated_property cp_stab ON cp_stab.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_stab.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
WHERE m.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
  AND cp_stab.value < (
      SELECT cp_ref_stab.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref_stab ON cp_ref_stab.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
        AND cp_ref_stab.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
      ORDER BY cp_ref_stab.value ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp_bm.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref_bm.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref_bm ON cp_ref_bm.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
        AND cp_ref_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
      ORDER BY cp_ref_bm.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    cp_stability.value AS stability_score,
    cp_lattice.value AS lattice_matching_score,
    cp_elastic.value AS elastic_score,
    cp_stability.value * cp_lattice.value * cp_elastic.value AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_l12 ON cp_l12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stability ON cp_stability.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_lattice ON cp_lattice.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_elastic ON cp_elastic.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp_l12.property_name = 'is_l12'
  AND cp_l12.value = 1
  AND cp_stability.property_name = 'stability_score'
  AND cp_lattice.property_name = 'lattice_matching_score'
  AND cp_elastic.property_name = 'elastic_score'
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
GROUP BY m.formula
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.chemical_system = 'Ni'
   OR m.chemical_system LIKE 'Ni-%'
   OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Ni'
   OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Ni-%'
ORDER BY m.formula ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.space_group_number

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula

    ps.is_stable,
    COALESCE(cp.tensor_component, cp.property_name) AS elastic_component,
    cp.value
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND (
      cp.property_name IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
      OR cp.tensor_component IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
  )
ORDER BY m.formula, elastic_component
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.is_stable,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.value >= 160

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, s.lattice_a,

SELECT DISTINCT

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m

WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

  AND string_to_array(m.chemical_system, '-') && ARRAY[
    'Sc','Ti','V','Cr','Mn','Fe','Co','Ni','Cu','Zn',
    'Y','Zr','Nb','Mo','Tc','Ru','Rh','Pd','Ag','Cd',
    'Hf','Ta','W','Re','Os','Ir','Pt','Au','Hg'
  ]
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_c11.value AS C11,
    cp_c12.value AS C12,
    cp_c44.value AS C44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC,
    cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_a_mismatch_to_ni3al
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
    (
        0.5 * (1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.0))) +
        0.3 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))) +
        0.2 * (cp.value / 300.0)
    ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,

FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND (
      EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c
          WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
            AND c.element = 'Ni'
      )
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c
          WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
            AND c.element = 'Co'
      )
  )
ORDER BY bulk_modulus DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT c_a.element AS a_site,
       c_b.element AS b_site,
       COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
GROUP BY c_a.element, c_b.element
ORDER BY stable_percentage DESC, avg_energy_above_hull ASC, combination_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,

  ps.energy_above_hull,

  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'

SELECT

    cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
    ps.energy_above_hull,

JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,

FROM material_entry m

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE
    (m.formula = 'Co3Ti' OR m.reduced_formula = 'Co3Ti')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'Q1: low formation energy / low hull distance'
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.05 THEN 'Q2: low formation energy / high hull distance'
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'Q3: high formation energy / low hull distance'
        ELSE 'Q4: high formation energy / high hull distance'
    END AS stability_quadrant
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY stability_quadrant, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE

SELECT

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m

JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  c.element AS a_site,
  CASE
    WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d transition metal'
    WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                       'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d/5d transition metal'
  END AS transition_metal_series,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
                    'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                    'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg')
ORDER BY transition_metal_series ASC, c.element ASC, ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
       m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       s.lattice_a,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND cp.value IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
      SELECT ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE (m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al')
        AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
        AND ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref2
      JOIN structure s_ref2 ON s_ref2.entry_id = m_ref2.entry_id
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref2.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
      WHERE (m_ref2.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref2.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al')
        AND (s_ref2.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref2.strukturbericht = 'L12')
        AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
        AND cp_ref.value IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0)) AS stability_score,
    1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS lattice_matching_score,
    cp_el.value AS elastic_score,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0)))
    * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
    * cp_el.value AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_el ON cp_el.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_el.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c.element = 'Ni'
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC

    FROM composition c
    JOIN element e ON e.symbol = c.element
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND e.block = 'd'
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       et.bulk_modulus_vrh, et.shear_modulus_vrh, et.youngs_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull, lattice_diff, et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a, et.bulk_modulus_vrh, et.shear_modulus_vrh, et.youngs_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c
              WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
              AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co'))
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a, et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, 
       ps.energy_above_hull, 
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff, 
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       (0.5 * (1 - ps.energy_above_hull) + 0.3 * (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) + 0.2 * cp_bm.value) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_ni WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_ni.element = 'Ni')
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_co WHERE c_co.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_co.element = 'Co'))
ORDER BY cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT c_a.element AS a_site, 
       c_b.element AS b_site,
       COUNT(*) AS total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ps.is_stable THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
GROUP BY c_a.element, c_b.element
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY lattice_diff ASC, cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.energy_above_hull, 
       et.bulk_modulus_vrh, et.shear_modulus_vrh, et.youngs_modulus,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, lattice_mismatch ASC, et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.energy_above_hull,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.element = 'Co'
ORDER BY lattice_diff ASC
LIMIT 10000;

WITH compound AS (
    SELECT m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE m.formula = 'Co3Ti'
    LIMIT 1
),
ref_energies AS (
    SELECT c.entry_id,
           SUM(comp.atomic_fraction * per.energy_per_atom) AS weighted_ref
    FROM compound c
    JOIN composition comp ON comp.entry_id = c.entry_id
    JOIN pure_element_reference per ON per.element_symbol = comp.element
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
)
SELECT c.formula,
       c.formation_energy_per_atom,
       r.weighted_ref AS ref_energy,
       c.formation_energy_per_atom - r.weighted_ref AS corrected_enthalpy
FROM compound c
JOIN ref_energies r ON r.entry_id = c.entry_id;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.energy_above_hull,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY lattice_diff ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, et.bulk_modulus_vrh, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY et.bulk_modulus_vrh ASC, s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN element e ON e.symbol = c.element
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND e.block IN ('d')
  AND e.period_number IN (4, 5, 6)
ORDER BY e.period_number, e.atomic_number
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull < 0.0
ORDER BY cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, 
       ps.energy_above_hull AS stability_score,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_mismatch_score,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus_score,
       (ps.energy_above_hull * ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) * cp_bm.value) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY composite_score ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_enthalpy
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_formation_enthalpy
LIMIT 10000;

WITH all_l12 AS (
    SELECT m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
),
enthalpy AS (
    SELECT al.entry_id, al.formula, al.formation_energy_per_atom,
           SUM(comp.atomic_fraction * per.energy_per_atom) AS weighted_ref
    FROM all_l12 al
    JOIN composition comp ON comp.entry_id = al.entry_id
    JOIN pure_element_reference per ON per.element_symbol = comp.element
    GROUP BY al.entry_id, al.formula, al.formation_energy_per_atom
),
ni_bearing AS (
    SELECT e.entry_id, e.formula,
           e.formation_energy_per_atom - e.weighted_ref AS delta_h_f
    FROM enthalpy e
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM composition c WHERE c.entry_id = e.entry_id AND c.element = 'Ni'
    )
)
SELECT formula, ROUND(delta_h_f::numeric, 4) AS corrected_enthalpy
FROM ni_bearing
ORDER BY delta_h_f ASC
LIMIT 5;

WITH corrected AS (
    SELECT m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
           SUM(c.atomic_fraction * per.energy_per_atom) AS weighted_ref
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN pure_element_reference per ON per.element_symbol = c.element
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    GROUP BY m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
)
SELECT formula,
       ROUND(formation_energy_per_atom::numeric, 4) AS raw_e_form,
       ROUND(weighted_ref::numeric, 4) AS weighted_ref,
       ROUND((formation_energy_per_atom - weighted_ref)::numeric, 4) AS corrected_e_form
FROM corrected
WHERE (formation_energy_per_atom - weighted_ref) < -0.1
ORDER BY (formation_energy_per_atom - weighted_ref) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

failures.question: L1₂化合物のうちNi3Alより安定でバルクモジュラスが高い候補を出して。
failures.gen_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
       m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       s.lattice_a,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND cp.value IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
      SELECT ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE (m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al')
        AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
        AND ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref2
      JOIN structure s_ref2 ON s_ref2.entry_id = m_ref2.entry_id
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref2.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
      WHERE (m_ref2.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref2.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al')
        AND (s_ref2.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref2.strukturbericht = 'L12')
        AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
        AND cp_ref.value IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
